title: EdgeBench benchmark result
description: One benchmark run: one model, one provider configuration, one or more trials. Schema version 1.2.0. Fields added in 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 are optional keys, so a 1.0.0 or 1.1.0 document with schema_version set to 1.2.0 is valid. See docs/results-schema.md.

schema_version.description: Schema version this document conforms to. Each version has its own schema file.

label.description: Optional human-readable name for the run.

stage.description: profiled_pass (added in 1.2.0): the --profile-accelerator session after the timed trials.

code.description: Error code from the failing component (e.g. an ONNX Runtime OrtErrorCode name), if any.

kind.description: The writer's own stable identifier of the failure, e.g. strict_mode_refusal, qnn_backend_load_failed, interrupted. Null if the writer has none.

unsupported_nodes.description: Nodes the execution provider reported it cannot run, when a strict-mode session was refused (kind strict_mode_refusal); empty if the refusal named none. Null for every other failure.

notes.description: Facts worth knowing that do not limit how the result may be used (unlike warnings), e.g. batch_rounding_only. Same shape as a warning. Added in 1.2.0.

git_dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes at build time.

build_type.description: CMake build configuration, e.g. Release or Debug.

implementation.description: Which implementation wrote the document: the C++ engine (cpp) or a Python script (python).

process_architecture.description: Architecture the edgebench process itself was built for. Differs from os.architecture when running under emulation.

power_mode.description: Windows power mode as reported by the OS, e.g. 'Best performance'.

power_plan.description: Active power plan (power scheme) name, e.g. Balanced.

battery_percent.description: Battery charge at the start of the run; null without a battery or if unknown.

oneOf.description: CPU load of other processes (this process's own CPU time excluded), sampled during the idle period before the first trial. Null if not sampled.

cpu_utilization_ratio.description: System-wide CPU utilization (0-1) sampled before the timed trials: background load.

runtime.description: Null only if the run failed before ONNX Runtime was loaded.

library_path.description: Absolute path of the onnxruntime library actually loaded.

api_version.description: ONNX Runtime C API version obtained from the library (ORT_API_VERSION of the headers the engine was built with).

load_check.description: full_path_verified: the C++ engine loaded onnxruntime.dll by absolute path from its own directory and checked its version and C API version. python_package: loaded through the onnxruntime Python package. not_checked: no check was made.

execution_provider.description: Null only in a failed result where no execution provider was created.

name.description: Execution provider used for the session, e.g. QNNExecutionProvider.

version.description: EP version, e.g. 2.8.0 for the QNN plugin EP. Null for built-in EPs without their own version.

library_path.description: Path of the plugin EP library, if the EP was registered from a library.

qnn.description: QNN-specific details. Null when the QNN EP is not used.

sdk_version.description: QNN SDK (QAIRT) version as reported at run time: major.minor.patch of the backend build id (backend_build), as the QNN EP reads it. Null if not reported; see value_sources for where it came from and backend_file_version for the version resource of the backend file.

backend_build.description: Build identifier reported by the backend (QnnBackend_getBuildId, as logged by the QNN EP while it sets up the backend), e.g. v2.52.0.261104115025. Null if not reported.

backend_file_version.description: Version resource of the backend library actually loaded in the process (e.g. QnnHtp.dll), read from the loaded module's file. Null if the module was not loaded or has no version resource.

module_path.description: Path of the loaded module the version was read from.

product_version.description: ProductVersion string of the version resource, e.g. 2.52.0.261104115025.

source.description: loaded_module_version_resource: the version resource of the file of the module loaded while a session was alive.

htp_arch.description: HTP architecture the QNN EP compiled an EP context of this run for, read from the device's platform info and stored in the context's compatibility info, e.g. v73. Null if the run built or loaded no EP context.

soc_model.description: SoC model as reported at run time. The QNN EP does not read it from the device (its compatibility info carries only its soc_model option), so it is null.

partition_count.description: Number of graph partitions (fused nodes) ONNX Runtime assigned to the QNN EP in the node placement session. Null if placement was not recorded.

unlisted_ep_options.description: ep_default: every QNN EP option not listed in config.ep_options was left at the EP's default value.

value_sources.description: Where sdk_version, backend_build, htp_arch and soc_model came from; null for a value that is null. qnn_ep_log_backend_build_id: the backend build id the QNN EP logs while it sets up its backend. ep_compatibility_info: the compatibility info the QNN EP stored in an EP context model of this run. Added in 1.2.0.

ep_device.description: The EP device the session was attached to. Null if no device-based selection was used.

vendor.description: Hardware vendor string; may be unset by the EP.

driver_version.description: Driver version of the device (e.g. the NPU driver).

metadata.description: Hardware device metadata of the selected device.

method.description: by_device_type: the EP device of the requested EP whose hardware type is the requested device type.

candidate_count.description: How many devices matched; a valid selection has exactly one.

loaded_modules.description: Every ONNX Runtime and QNN DLL loaded in the process (onnxruntime*.dll, Qnn*.dll), captured while the session was alive.

ep_devices.description: Every EP device ONNX Runtime enumerated, not only the selected one. Null if the devices could not be enumerated (failed results only).

model.description: Null only if the run failed before the model file was read.

opset.description: Opset version of the default ONNX domain.

stored_precision.description: Precision of the weights/compute as stored in the model file.

identifier.description: Model/weights identifier within the library, e.g. mobilenet_v2/IMAGENET1K_V2.

export_tool.description: Tool and version that produced the ONNX file, e.g. 'torch.onnx 2.13.0'.

precision_notes.description: Known differences between stored precision and how the hardware computes.

normalization.description: Where input normalization happens: external (before the model, not timed), in_graph (Sub/Div nodes in the model, timed), folded (merged into the first layer's weights).

compute_precision.description: Compute precision explicitly requested from the EP (e.g. via an EP option). Null if left at the EP default.

strict_mode.description: True if CPU fallback was disabled (session.disable_cpu_ep_fallback = 1).

batch_size.description: Items per inference. Null only in a failed result where it could not be determined.

preprocessing.description: How inputs were prepared (decode, resize, normalization). Preprocessing is never part of the timed region (timing.scope).

ort_execution_mode.description: ONNX Runtime graph execution mode (ORT_SEQUENTIAL / ORT_PARALLEL).

intra_op_threads.description: Requested value; null if left at the ONNX Runtime default.

inter_op_threads.description: Requested value; null if left at the ONNX Runtime default.

session_config.description: Session config entries set explicitly, e.g. session.disable_cpu_ep_fallback.

ep_context_cache.description: EP context (precompiled model) cache. Null when the EP has no context cache (e.g. the CPU EP).

cache_file.description: File name of the EP context model, if enabled.

state.description: Null if the run failed before the cache was examined. disabled: no EP context cache. generated: no cache existed for this model; it was built in this run. loaded: an existing cache with a matching key was used. regenerated: a cache for this model existed (with another key, or with this key and --ep-cache build); it was deleted and rebuilt.

files.description: Files of the cache: the EP context model and its context binaries.

mode.description: off: no EP context cache (enabled is false); every timed session is compiled from the ONNX model. build: the run deleted any cache for this key, built it once before the trials, and created every timed session from it. use: the run created its timed sessions from the existing cache whose key matched (hit true), or built it first if there was none (hit false).

key_id.description: The cache key as one string: SHA256 of the key object (the key fields) serialized as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace. The cache files are named by it.

context_path.description: Absolute path of the EP context model (_ctx.onnx) the timed sessions were created from.

hit.description: True if a valid cache with a matching key existed before the run and was used (mode use). False if the run built the cache (mode build, or use without one). Null when the cache is off.

verified_equal_outputs.description: Whether a session created from the cache gave bit-identical outputs to a session compiled from the ONNX model, on the same input. Null if not checked.

cache_dir.description: Absolute path of the cache directory (one subdirectory per key id). Also set with mode off when --init-breakdown built its per-trial contexts there. Null if the run used no EP context.

embed_mode.description: ep.context_embed_mode of the contexts the run built or used: 0, the context binary in its own file next to the context model. Null if the run used no EP context.

compatibility.description: The compatibility info the EP stored in the context model the timed sessions were created from, and the EP's verdict on it for the selected device. Null with mode off. Added in 1.2.0.

info.description: The model's ep_compatibility_info.<EP> metadata, e.g. v2:6:2.52.0:5.52.0:73:0:0:0 for the QNN EP. Null if the model has none.

verdict.description: OrtCompiledModelCompatibility for the selected device. prefer_recompilation: usable, but the EP would compile it differently now (ONNX Runtime then logs that recompiling is suggested). Null if not rated.

oneOf.description: The key fields: everything a cache depends on. A cache whose key differs from the current run is stale.

model_sha256.description: SHA256 of the source ONNX model.

ep_options_sha256.description: SHA256 of config.ep_options serialized as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace.

qnn_backend_file_version.description: ProductVersion of the HTP backend file (QnnHtp.dll) the context was compiled with. Added in 1.2.0.

ep_options.description: Every EP option passed. Added in 1.2.0.

session_config.description: Every session config entry that affects compilation (all but ep.context_enable and ep.context_file_path). Added in 1.2.0.

graph_optimization_level.description: ONNX Runtime graph optimization level: it decides the graph the EP compiles. Added in 1.2.0.

run_binding.description: run: Session::Run with input/output values created per call. iobinding_preallocated: IoBinding with input and output buffers allocated once.

init_breakdown.description: True if every trial also timed a cold, a context-building and a cached session creation (timing.trials[].session_init) before its timed session. Added in 1.2.0.

profiling.description: Profiling settings of the sessions that produced timing.trials. Profiled sessions are never timed; see timing.accelerator.

ort.description: ONNX Runtime profiling enabled on the timed sessions.

qnn_level.description: QNN EP profiling_level of the timed sessions.

execution.description: Null only if the run failed before a session was created.

full_device_execution_verified.description: True: verified that the whole graph ran on the requested device. False: verified that it did not. Null: not verified.

verification_method.description: qnn_validation_log: from the QNN EP's per-node validation log (execution.qnn_validation). ort_profile: from the provider of each node in an ONNX Runtime profile. combined: more than one method agreed; verification_details lists them.

verification_details.description: How placement was verified. A string (1.0.0, 1.1.0), or from 1.2.0 an object with that text and the evidence behind it.

qnn_validation_passes.description: Per QNN EP capability pass (same order as execution.qnn_validation.passes): the node units the EP validated, counted by operator type. Null if no QNN validation log was captured.

module_checks.description: Every check that each ONNX Runtime and QNN module in the process came from the bundle directory, in order: after the execution provider was created (and its library registered), after each untimed and each timed session was created, and while the node placement session was alive.

stage.description: after_untimed_session: after a session that is not timed (EP context build and the cached == compiled check before the trials; --init-breakdown sessions of a trial). profiled_session: after the --profile-accelerator session was created.

trial_index.description: The trial whose session was checked (after_session_creation, and after_untimed_session for --init-breakdown sessions).

deleted_stale_cache_files.description: Files the run deleted from the EP context cache because they belonged to a stale entry (same model and configuration, built by another ONNX Runtime, QNN EP, QNN SDK or backend version or for another device), as absolute paths. Empty if none. Added to the 1.2.0 object in place.

background_load_samples.description: Every background-load sample above the background_cpu_load_high threshold, with where its CPU time went: the top other processes by share (image name only), this process's own share (not part of the load) and the busy time no process accounts for (interrupts, DPCs). Empty if none. Added to the 1.2.0 object in place.

effective_precision.description: The precision the model was stored in and the precision the device computed in. Null if not determined.

source.description: model: the device computes in the model's stored precision. enable_htp_fp16_precision: the QNN HTP backend computes an FP32 model in FP16 because that EP option was set.

batch_equivalence.description: How this model file, on this provider and compute precision, compares with the batch-1 file of the same model variant: whether every batch item's output is bit-identical (bitwise_equal_to_b1) and, where it is not, whether any prediction changes (predictions_equal_to_b1). A result whose predictions differ measures a different computation and must not be averaged or compared with batch-1 results as if it were the same one; one that differs only in the last bits may. Null if not determined.

bitwise_equal_to_b1.description: True if every batch item's output is bit-identical to the batch-1 file's output for the same input.

bitwise_basis.description: batch_size_1: the model has batch size 1 (equal by definition). reference_outputs: from the committed reference outputs (models/batch_equivalence.json), looked up by model SHA256, provider and compute precision. not_available: no reference entry for this model file.

predictions_equal_to_b1.description: True if no prediction differs from the batch-1 file's (see predictions_basis).

predictions_basis.description: bitwise: the outputs are bit-identical, so the predictions are equal. eval_quick_top1: the top-1 class of every ImageNetV2 eval-quick image (1,000) at this batch size against batch 1. test_split_flags: the anomaly flag of every test-split window at the batch-1 file's threshold, against batch 1. not_available: not determined.

predictions_differing.description: Of those, how many predictions differ from batch 1.

oneOf.description: What the QNN EP reported when it validated the graph's nodes. Null if no validation log was captured.

passes.description: One entry per QNN EP capability pass, in order.

node_index.description: Node index the QNN EP reported. Null if it gave none.

timing.description: Null only if the run failed before a session was created.

ep_context_state.description: cold: compiled from the ONNX graph; cached: loaded from an EP context model; not_used: EP has no context cache.

cold_ms.description: Session creations from the ONNX model without a cache, one entry per creation. Null if none were made.

context_build_ms.description: Creation of the session that wrote the EP context cache. Null if no cache was built.

cached_ms.description: Session creations from the EP context model, one entry per creation. Null if no cache was used.

oneOf.description: Statistics of the per-trial session_init values (timing.trials[].session_init) over the trials that measured them.

first_inference_ms.description: Latency of the first warm-up inference, which often includes one-time setup.

oneOf.description: Session initialization of this trial. Each value is null when that kind of initialization was not measured in the trial.

cold_ms.description: Creation of a session from the ONNX model without an EP context cache (the entry of session_init.cold_ms for this trial).

context_build_ms.description: Creation of the session that wrote the EP context cache.

cached_init_ms.description: Creation of a session from the EP context model.

stats.description: Computed over all measured iterations of all trials pooled.

trial_spread.description: Whether the trials agree, judged on the per-trial medians (p50): one slow iteration moves a trial's mean (trial_variation, kept as data) but not its median. high is true if the medians' coefficient of variation exceeds cv_threshold_ratio or the slowest median exceeds the fastest by more than max_to_min_threshold; then the result carries a trial_spread_high warning. Added to the 1.2.0 object in place.

judged_on.description: The per-trial statistic the spread is judged on.

scope.description: What the timed region covers: the inference call only. Input decoding, resizing and normalization are excluded.

oneOf.description: Accelerator-side time from a separate profiled pass, never from the timed runs: profiling slows down the host side, so its wall times are not used. Null if not measured.

accelerator_execute_us_median.description: Median accelerator execute time per inference.

rpc_execute_us_median.description: Median RPC execute time per inference (the call across to the accelerator).

separate_run.description: Always true: the values come from a separate profiled pass, never from the timed runs.

oneOf.description: Accelerator-side time from a separate profiled session, created and run after the timed trials. Profiling slows the host side down, so nothing measured in this pass is part of the timed latency fields (timing.trials, timing.aggregate, session_init), and nothing from the timed sessions is in here. Null if no profiled pass was run. Supersedes timing.accelerator.

iterations.description: Inferences run in the profiled session.

accelerator_ms.description: Accelerator execute time per inference, from the profile.

source.description: The QNN EP profiling level the times come from.

level.description: The QNN EP option profiling_level of the profiled session. Added in 1.2.0.

warmup_iterations.description: Inferences run before the profiled ones; their profile entries are not used. Added in 1.2.0.

inferences_in_profile.description: Inferences the profile reports, warm-up included. Added in 1.2.0.

reported_unit.description: Unit of the times in the profile (they are recorded here in ms). Added in 1.2.0.

execute_events_ms.description: Every per-inference execute event of the profile (e.g. RPC (execute) time, QNN (execute) time), summarized over the profiled inferences. accelerator_ms is its Accelerator (execute) time. Added in 1.2.0.

init_events.description: Events of the profiled session's creation the profile reports (graph finalization), in order. Added in 1.2.0.

path.description: Relative to the result file once the result was written (in the run directory), else absolute.

files.description: The profiling output the EP wrote (CSV and its binary log). Added in 1.2.0.

scope.description: Memory of the edgebench process only; device-side NPU memory is not included.

session_create_working_set_delta_bytes.description: Change of the process working set across session creation. Process working set only; memory on the NPU or in drivers outside the process is not included.

latencies_file.description: Path relative to this result file.

timestampUtc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with a Z suffix.

path.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the field the warning is about, if any.

shape.description: Integer for a fixed dimension, string for a named symbolic dimension, null for an unnamed unknown dimension.

count.description: Number of measured inferences these stats cover.

stddev_ms.description: Sample standard deviation (n-1). Null if count < 2.

path.description: Absolute path the module was loaded from.

vendor.description: Hardware vendor string as reported; the QNN EP reports an empty string.

metadata.description: Hardware device metadata, e.g. Description, LUID.

ep_metadata.description: EP metadata for this device, e.g. version, library_path.
